name: publipulse
description: PubliPulse monorepo — secure public health action platform (API + web command center + field app).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,field -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @publipulse/api" "npm run dev -w @publipulse/web" "npm run dev -w @publipulse/field"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @publipulse/api" "npm run dev -w @publipulse/web"
scripts.dev:field: concurrently -k -n api,field -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @publipulse/api" "npm run dev -w @publipulse/field"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @publipulse/shared && npm run build -w @publipulse/api && npm run build -w @publipulse/web && npm run build -w @publipulse/field
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @publipulse/shared && npm run build -w @publipulse/api && npm run build -w @publipulse/web
scripts.build:field: npm run build -w @publipulse/shared && npm run build -w @publipulse/field
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @publipulse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @publipulse/api && npm run typecheck -w @publipulse/web && npm run typecheck -w @publipulse/field
scripts.test: npm run test:tools && npm run build -w @publipulse/shared && npm run test -w @publipulse/api && npm run test -w @publipulse/shared
